analysis: Dobutamine primarily acts on beta-1 adrenergic receptors and does not activate peripheral dopaminergic receptors, unlike dopamine which affects both dopaminergic and adrenergic receptors. This difference is significant in their clinical use, particularly in how they influence cardiac output and renal blood flow.
